name: Gonadoblastoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and immunohistochemical diagnostic criteria for gonadoblastoma

criteria.description: Presence of nests of germ cells and sex cord-stromal cells with calcifications on histopathology
Positive immunohistochemical staining for markers such as OCT3/4, PLAP, and inhibin
Association with gonadal dysgenesis or disorders of sex development

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of characteristic cell nests with positive immunohistochemical markers
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires correlation with clinical and genetic findings, especially in patients with disorders of sex development.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Female external genitalia in individual with 46,XY karyotype
searchTerms: female external sex organs in XY individual

common.symptomName: Gonadal dysgenesis with female appearance, male
searchTerms: gonadal development failure with female appearance in males
sex development disorder with female traits

laboratory: Elevated alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in some cases
Hormonal imbalances related to gonadal dysfunction
imaging: Ultrasound or MRI showing gonadal mass with calcifications
CT scan for tumor extent and metastasis evaluation
genetic: Association with disorders of sex development including 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis
Presence of Y chromosome material in dysgenetic gonads
other: Histopathology showing nests of germ cells and sex cord-stromal cells with calcifications
Immunohistochemical positivity for OCT3/4, PLAP, inhibin

distinguishingFeatures: Pure germ cell tumor without sex cord-stromal component
Composed predominantly of sex cord-stromal cells without germ cell nests

redFlags: Presence of Y chromosome material in dysgenetic gonads
Signs of malignant transformation or metastasis
references: Nielsen SM, et al. Gonadoblastoma: a review of clinical and pathological features. Endocr Pathol. 2019.
Ulbright TM, et al. Gonadoblastoma and related lesions. Semin Diagn Pathol. 2017.
